points.description: Gives the final value 850, reached by a mathematically valid argument: the reciprocal of each root's modulus squared, 1/(rᵢ̄rᵢ) = 1/|rᵢ|², is summed over all 10 roots and halved because the roots come in conjugate pairs with equal modulus. Equivalent valid methods, such as substituting w = 13 - 1/x with w^10 = -1 and summing |13 - w|² over the ten roots of w^10 = -1, also earn the mark. The mark is lost if any step is invalid or the final answer is not 850.

rubric.notes: The question is worth a single mark, so the answer is all-or-nothing: full credit requires the correct final value 850 with every step valid. Any valid method, including the substitution w = 13 - 1/x, earns the mark. An incorrect final value or an invalid step earns no marks.
